It lies at the confluence of the Basăk (Bassac), Sab, and Mekong river systems, in the south-central part of the country.PhnomPenhwas founded in 1434 to succeed Angkor Thom as the capital of the Khmer nation but was abandoned several times before being reestablished in 1865 by King Norodom.
